title: Chreode: A Cell World Model for One-Step Temporal Dynamics and Perturbation Prediction
reviewer_a_anchors: Secs. 3-5 and Tables 1-4; Sec. 7; Apps. A.4, E, and I
reviewer_b_anchors: Abstract and pp. 2-7; Tables 1-4 pp. 8-9; Scope pp. 9-10; Appendices A-C pp. 12-16; ablations pp. 17-18; NeurIPS checklist pp. 19-25
adjudication_anchors: Abstract; Secs. 3-5 and Tables 1-4; Sec. 7; Appendix A.4; Appendix I; NeurIPS checklist
adjudication_notes: One-step transitions at multiple elapsed-time targets support dynamics=1, not trajectory-level dynamics or rollout. The optional action token is null during temporal pretraining, and Norman perturbation results replace a GEARS embedding rather than test a standalone Chreode action operator, so action=0. Stochastic samples are used for generation without uncertainty evaluation, so uncertainty=0. Intervention/do(a) language invokes an alternative-intervention interpretation but no effect contrast, identification, overlap analysis, or counterfactual validation is supplied, so causal=0 and explicit estimand=no. Fate and perturbation tasks are downstream probes, so decision=1. Qualitative dual-use discussion without a hazard test gives safety=1. Frozen external validation=yes only for the zero-shot Weinreb clonal-fate analysis; time-transition and GEARS evaluations are adapted/fine-tuned transfer.

title: Towards Surgical World-Action Modeling: A Preliminary Joint Visual-Trajectory Forecasting for Surgical Motion Planning
reviewer_a_anchors: Secs. 2-3, Table 1, and Sec. 4; qualitative-results repository
reviewer_b_anchors: Secs. 1-2 pp. 2-6; Fig. 1 p. 4; Sec. 3 pp. 6-8 and Table 1 p. 8; Fig. 2 and conclusion pp. 8-9
adjudication_anchors: Title and abstract; Secs. 1-2 and Fig. 1; Sec. 3 and Table 1; Fig. 2; conclusion
adjudication_notes: Planning is the highest stated claim because the title, introduction, and benchmark framing repeatedly position the model for surgical motion planning. The demonstrated model is nevertheless strictly passive: it forecasts recorded expert motion as an output and does not condition on, select, optimize, or execute an action, so action evidence=0 against the planning claim. Because there is no action input to remove or perturb, the descriptive action-agnostic-comparator and action-perturbation fields are NA. Its recursive 15-step prediction is still a genuine free-running rollout and supports the retained dynamics/rollout scores.
